- Crafting table : 6 x [[gv:nugget_co60|Cobalt-60 Nugget]].
- Crafting table (x3) : 2 x [[gv:ingot_co60|Cobalt-60 Ingot]].
- Crafting table : [[gv:rod_co60|Cobalt-60 Rod]].
(2 more recipes: see JEI.)

[[gv:ingot_co60|Cobalt-60 Ingot]], [[gv:nugget_co60|Cobalt-60 Nugget]], [[gv:pellet_rtg_cobalt|Cobalt-60 RTG Pellet]].
